gen-megrim-gf-noto-sans-warang-citi: Noto Sans Warang Citi makes words read as solid blocks. Megrim is the angular, futuristic one, every stroke ending at a measured thickness, while the sans body opens wide channels into each counter.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-aldrich: Bookish nostalgia with a modern edge. Mystery Quest brings open-jawed curves and compact ascenders up top, while Aldrich follows below, tracing one thick thread with its x-height close to the caps.
gen-nixie-one-gf-orbit: Retro-tech lettering with gaps to spare. Nixie One is best at open, constant-stroke curves with a nostalgic hum, while Orbit, the sans-serif body, keeps each character floating apart with rope-like stems.
